name: elm-clipboard
description: JavaScript side of the ianramosc/elm-clipboard Elm package: clipboard ports and copy/paste custom elements
author: Ian Ramos

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=ElmClipboard --target=es2020 --minify --outfile=dist/elm-clipboard.iife.js
scripts.e2e:prepare: npm run build && cd ../examples && elm make src/Main.elm --output=elm.js && cp ../js/dist/elm-clipboard.iife.js elm-clipboard.js
